packageRules.description: The chart deploys this repo's own image. values.yaml leaves image.tag empty so it defaults to the chart appVersion, and the deployment template renders repository:tag, so a digest pin would produce an invalid image reference.
Keep the runtime image on nginx stable (even minor) releases.
uv is pinned in the generator Dockerfile and in validate.yml; bump both together.
ruff is pinned in the uv dev group and in the pre-commit hook; bump both together.
